title: Lane bootstrap should resolve the Yeroket kernel checkout for paired worktrees
body: The GB1 brief named a kernel .claude-worktrees/gb1k without naming the kernel repository. The first worktree creation targeted the Undertow facade checkout; recovery required removing it and recreating the lane under /home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy. Existing VIXEN codegen root probing also assumes a different sibling layout. Make the workspace/launcher contract identify the Yeroket-Fantasy kernel root and validate the selected repository before creating or pairing a lane worktree. Tier luna: this crosses lane provisioning and VIXEN provider discovery. Exact recovery: git worktree add -b lane-gb1k /home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy/.claude-worktrees/gb1k lane-d11row.
